description:
“I wanted you. It’s not that I hated you… but I can’t live being treated like this.

”Min Jeong-ha, adopted as the youngest son into a prestigious shaman family that has served the rich and powerful for generations.Jeong-ha grew up basking in the undivided attention and affection of his three-years-older brother, Min Ji-han, a man who was both impeccably upright and gifted in business. But the moment Jeong-ha enters university, he falls from grace and becomes the family’s biggest problem child.
The reason behind his sudden change? He discovered the shocking truth: he had been adopted solely to serve as a sacrificial charm, a human talisman to ward off calamity for the Min family.
Betrayed by the people he once called family, Jeong-ha burns with rage and pushes Ji-han away.In response, Ji-han begins to force himself on the now-distant Jeong-ha. To win him back, he decides to eliminate the “problem” once and for all…Jeong-ha tried to escape his brother’s disastrous obsession, but instead, he ended up summoning an even greater catastrophe.
